body.p: The Chat view in AI Positron has a drop-down menu where you can choose between custom chat modes (e.g. Chat/Ask/DITA Agent). Each of these chat modes define an initial prompt and a set of tools that are used when the chat is started. Extra chat modes can be added by creating custom AI actions with a specific output-action, as exemplified below:{ "id": "my.custom.chat.mode", "title": "S1000D", "description": "Chat with the AI about your S1000D project.", "categoryId": "Chat modes", "output-action": "agentic", "prompt_ref": "prompts/s100d-detailed-prompt.md", "expand-params": [ { "name": "applicationContext", "value": "${applicationContext}" } ], "parameters": { "function_refs": [ {"ref": "get_current_document_location"}, {"ref": "get_document_content"}, {"ref": "search_project_resources"}, {"ref": "search_webhelp_content"}, {"ref": "grep_project"}, {"ref": "list_dir"}, {"ref": "copy_move_rename_path"}, {"ref": "run_command_line"}, {"ref": "edit_document"}, {"ref": "invoke_ai_action"}, {"ref": "retrieve_ai_actions"}, {"ref": "get_xml_refactoring_operations"}, {"ref": "get_xml_refactoring_operation_params"}, {"ref": "refactor_xml_with_operation"}, {"ref": "refactor_xml_with_xslt"}, {"ref": "store_to_memory"}, {"ref": "update_memory"}, {"ref": "validate_content"} ] } }

Tools contributed by other plugins and add-ons, as well as tools provided by configured MCP servers, do not need to be listed in function_refs. They are automatically added to every chat mode. In the Oxygen XML desktop application, tools contributed by the application itself, such as compare_documents and get_profiling_conditions, are also automatically added to every chat mode. The following exceptions apply to tools contributed by the application, plugins, and add-ons:
A chat mode whose ID ends in .ask, such as the built-in Ask chat mode, is offered only contributed tools that declare that they do not make changes.
A chat mode that runs from a transformation through the AI XPath functions receives only the tools listed in its function_refs.
A contributed tool that replaces a built-in tool is offered only to chat modes that list the built-in tool.

section.title: Defining a Chat Mode or Sub-Agent in a Markdown File
section.p: Instead of using an action JSON file and a separate prompt file, you can define a chat mode, a sub-agent that other AI agents delegate work to, or even an AI action in a single Markdown file. For details and examples, see .
